results.title: Ick
results.overview: Science teacher Hank’s life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects that a new student may be his daughter—all while facing an alien threat in their town.

results.title: Meet, Greet & Bye
results.overview: A mother, who loves watching K-dramas, decides to stop her chemo treatment after losing hope of getting better. Her only dream before dying is to meet her ultimate K-drama idol, who is visiting Manila for a series of events. Her four children agree to work together with the condition that once their mother meets their idol, she will undergo therapy before her time runs out.

results.title: Tainted Love
results.overview: A former couple are forced to work together one last time. As sparks  start to reignite, their mission turns into a deadly reckoning with the past.

results.title: The Flesh Itself
results.overview: Amid the Paraguayan War, three deserter soldiers seek refuge in an isolated frontier house inhabited by a rancher and a young woman. What seems like sanctuary soon reveals itself as far more horrifying than the war itself.

results.title: Desert Dawn
results.overview: A newly appointed small-town sheriff and his begrudging deputy get tangled up in a web of lies and corruption involving shady businessmen and the cartel while investigating the murder of a mysterious woman.

results.title: Confia: Sonho de Cria
results.overview: Nando dreams of being a great Trap singer, but until his dream comes true, he makes deliveries for Lanchudo, a snack bar in Copacabana.

results.title: Mourning Glory
results.overview: Lost soul Dermot is newly widowed and turns to an unusual pastime to process his pain. But his gatecrashing of every wake he can across rural county Antrim doesn’t go unnoticed. The new funeral director and her young son catch him in the act but then make him an offer he surely can’t refuse.

results.title: Muslihat
results.overview: An orphanage moved to a new and more suitable place for the children to live. However, unexpectedly, a number of mystical disturbances occur.

results.title: Vespertine
results.overview: An assault on a top female entertainment lawyer fast-tracks a reunion for four long-lost friends; an unexpected offering from a desert flower turns daytime debauchery into an alluring exploration of unresolved stories at twilight.

results.title: Amityville Bloodlines
results.overview: Amityville Bloodlines unleashes a sadistic killer tied to the twisted experiments of the long lost Dr. Trevor. As new victims are drawn into the town's bloody legacy, the murders grow more brutal and the secrets more disturbing, Packed with killer deaths and a darker, more immersive story-evil has returned to Amityville.

results.title: Harder and Harder
results.overview: Sequel to 'The Most Australian Band Ever!

results.title: Mother of Flies
results.overview: When a young woman faces a deadly diagnosis, she seeks dark magic from a witch in the woods... but every cure has costs.

results.title: Escape from the Outland
results.overview: The couple of Ma Xiao, a foreign correspondent, and Pan Wenjia, a volunteer doctor, accompanied engineer Miao Feng on a trip to the suburbs to repair a base station. During the trip, the local situation suddenly changed and the three were kidnapped by an extremist organisation. While in prison, they met Zhou Weijie, an overseas Chinese businessman. In order to find a chance of survival, they embarked on a journey of escape in the midst of barbaric warfare and chaos.

results.title: Agapito
results.overview: It's the last day of the month. Bowlers flock to the lanes of a bowling alley that has seen better days. Mira, the bowling alley's manager, decides to close early. She's awaiting the arrival of a special visitor.

results.title: The Underdogs
results.overview: After finding treasure capable of changing their lives, a group of friends end up with a disasterous problem they must solve.

results.title: The Regulars
results.overview: Set in London's iconic Prince Charles Cinema, The Regulars follows a day in the life of its hapless employees. During their shift they watch movies, argue with customers, and, above all, deal with each other.

results.title: Doom Boogie
results.overview: A few years after the breakup of her band, now divorced and disillusioned, Kathryn is at a low point. An unexpected invitation for a weekend getaway from her former lead singer promises to be a much needed escape. The wild drive up north is a reminder of her past life on the road and why she left it behind. Following a run-in with some locals, the band arrives at the cottage to find their host is missing. A menacing stranger leaves them all shaken… as dusk settles in, the siege of terror begins.
